shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in package.json next.config.ts tsconfig.json app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do printf '\\n### %s\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort && test -d node_modules && echo 'node_modules: present' || echo 'node_modules: absent' && test -f next-env.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' next-env.d.ts || true"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && git log -1 --oneline --stat && git show HEAD:package.json 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc "find .next -type f \\( -name '*.html' -o -name '*.rsc' -o -name '*index*' \\) -maxdepth 6 -print | sort | sed -n '1,160p' && rg -n --hidden -g '"'!cache/**'"' 'Dashboard|Loading dashboard|Total Revenue' .next/server .next/static 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,160p' app/loading.tsx && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx app/loading.tsx tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const html = readFileSync('.next/server/app/index.html', 'utf8'); const bodyBeforeScripts = html.slice(0, html.indexOf('
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' .gitignore && git diff -- tsconfig.json && git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed -n '1,120p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx && git diff --no-index /dev/null app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx || true'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,120p'; nl -ba app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx | sed -n '1,120p'; nl -ba app/loading.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'"
